data_description.host: Pick a unit found on this network, or type an IP address or hostname.
data_description.port: The Tide16's WebSocket port. Leave this alone unless you have changed it on the unit.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from that address. The Tide16 leaves the network in standby, so wake it and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Tide16 is already set up.

init.title: Audio detection
init.description: "Silent" is not the same level on every system. An analog input, or a source that keeps a low-level signal alive between tracks, can sit far above true digital silence. If Audio Signal never turns off, your floor is above this level — raise it. If it turns off during quiet scenes, lower it.

data.silence_level: Treat output below this level as silence

data_description.silence_level: Lower values keep Audio Signal on through quieter material. Run the "Measure output level" action with nothing playing to see your own noise floor.
data_description.silence_hold: How long the output must stay below that level before Audio Signal turns off. Pauses between words and scene cuts are shorter than this. Audio starting is always reported immediately.
